statements:
drop policy if exists "Academic staff read school results" on public.schoolpro_results;
create policy "Leadership read school results" on public.schoolpro_results for select to authenticated using(
 private.is_admin(array['super_admin'::public.user_role]) or
 private.has_school_access(school_id,array['proprietor'::public.school_member_role,'administrator'::public.school_member_role,'exam_officer'::public.school_member_role,'head_teacher'::public.school_member_role,'vice_principal'::public.school_member_role])
);
create policy "Teachers read assigned results" on public.schoolpro_results for select to authenticated using(
 exists(
  select 1
  from public.schoolpro_students st
  join public.schoolpro_subject_assignments sa
    on sa.school_id=schoolpro_results.school_id
   and sa.class_id=st.class_id
   and sa.subject_id=schoolpro_results.subject_id
   and sa.session=schoolpro_results.session
  join public.schoolpro_members m
    on m.id=sa.teacher_member_id
   and m.school_id=schoolpro_results.school_id
  where st.id=schoolpro_results.student_id
    and st.school_id=schoolpro_results.school_id
    and st.status='active'
    and m.user_id=(select auth.uid())
    and m.role in ('teacher'::public.school_member_role,'class_teacher'::public.school_member_role)
 )
);
